sections.title: Who QEhome is for
paragraphs: QEhome is not a university residence or a flat for a full academic year. It is a holiday apartment for visits and short stays linked to UManresa, FUB or other faculties in the university area.
It fits if you come for a few days: parents visiting students, visiting lecturers, training courses, conferences or short placements.

Lecturers and researchers passing through
Training, conferences and events
Temporary stays of several days or a week

sections.title: Distances and how to get there
paragraphs: QEhome is on Carrer Doctor Esteve, in central Manresa, not on campus. UManresa recommends Manresa-Baixador FGC station for reaching the university. From the apartment that stop is a few minutes on foot.
Times are approximate at a walking pace (about 4 to 5 km/h) or by car in normal traffic.
items: UManresa (Av. Universitària): about 10 to 15 minutes on foot, or about 5 minutes by car
University area: the same trip; the campus sits in that area
Manresa-Baixador FGC (stop recommended by UManresa): about 5 to 10 minutes on foot
Historic centre (Plaça Major): about 20 to 25 minutes on foot, or about 5 minutes by car

sections.title: The simple route if you stay 1 or 2 nights
paragraphs: This guide does not try to list all of Manresa's heritage. It is the route we would recommend to someone staying one or two nights: the essentials on foot in the centre, with clear options if you have more time.
The old town is walkable. If you stay at QEhome, Manresa-Baixador FGC station is about 5 to 10 minutes on foot and the historic centre about 20 to 25 minutes.

sections.title: If you only have a few hours (half a day)
paragraphs: Prioritise the Seu, old town and river axis. It fits in a morning or an afternoon without rushing too hard.
items: The Seu (Basilica of Santa Maria)
Carrer del Balç and Barri Antic streets
Plaça Major
Pont Vell
Cave of Saint Ignatius and a walk by the Cardener

sections.title: Manresa in one day
paragraphs: A full day in the centre. Combine heritage, shopping streets and the Cardener setting.
items: Morning: the Seu, Carrer del Balç, Plaça Major and the old town.
Midday: Passeig Pere III, shops and lunch in the centre.
Afternoon: Pont Vell, the Cave of Saint Ignatius and a walk by the Cardener.
Optional if you have time: Museu del Barroc de Catalunya (near the Cave).

sections.title: Essentials (short selection)
paragraphs: Seven concrete stops. For opening times and tickets, check Manresa Turisme or each venue's website.
items: The Seu: the Gothic basilica shapes the historic centre skyline.
Carrer del Balç: a covered medieval street, typical of the Barri Antic.
Plaça Major and old town: the city's commercial and urban heart.
Museu del Barroc de Catalunya: a Baroque collection in the Ignatian setting.
Pont Vell: historic bridge over the Cardener, on the way to the Cave.
Cave of Saint Ignatius: a key site on the Ignatian Way and of Saint Ignatius's memory in Manresa.
Passeig Pere III: a central promenade for lunch, shopping or ending the day.

sections.title: If you have two days
paragraphs: Day two does not have to be only a trip out of town. You can stay in Manresa or explore the county.
items: Option A, stay in Manresa: Museu del Barroc, Parc de l'Agulla, modernist buildings in the centre, or the Museu de l'Aigua i el Tèxtil / Séquia area.
Option B, day trip: Montserrat (about 30 minutes by car, depending on traffic), wine tourism in Pla de Bages, or Món Sant Benet.
If you choose Montserrat or wineries, leave the car in the building parking and avoid street parking when you return.

sections.title: Manresa, end of the Ignatian Way
paragraphs: The Ignatian Way reaches Manresa, a city linked to Saint Ignatius's stay and the Cave of Saint Ignatius. For many pilgrims the route ends here, or it is a long stage before continuing.
In the centre you have services, shops and Ignatian heritage a short walk away. QEhome is on Carrer Doctor Esteve, near Manresa-Baixador FGC station.

sections.title: When you arrive in Manresa
paragraphs: The Pilgrim Welcome Centre is at Via Sant Ignasi, 40 (ground floor of the old Saint Ignatius college). You can stamp your credential there. Usual hours: 10:00 to 18:00, Monday to Sunday. Closed on 25 and 26 December and on 1 and 6 January.
The Ignatian Way certificate (Ignaciana) can be collected at the Manresa Tourist Office on Plaça Major, with a credential stamped according to the route requirements.
If you arrive outside Welcome Centre hours, you can stamp the next day. At QEhome check-in is self-service: you do not need a front desk to shower and rest.

sections.title: A place to rest after the stage
paragraphs: After walking, what helps is arriving, getting in without waiting, and having space to recover. Self check-in is the main benefit on this page: useful if the day runs long or the train is late.
Full kitchen for dinner or breakfast without going out. Full bathroom. Two bedrooms if you travel as a couple or a small group. WiFi. If you arrive by car, private parking in the building.

enoturismoPage.h1: Wine tourism in Pla de Bages from Manresa
enoturismoPage.heroSubtitle: DO Pla de Bages wine route with a city base. Sleep in the centre, drive to wineries and return without hunting for parking.

sections.title: Why stay in Manresa to visit Pla de Bages
paragraphs: Pla de Bages is a wine designation with family wineries, vineyards and landscape a short drive from Manresa. The wine route works best by car: booked visits, tastings and a return to town for dinner or rest.
QEhome is not a rural house among vineyards. It is an urban apartment with private parking and an electric car charger: go out to wineries by day and return to the centre.

sections.title: Wineries near Manresa (with visits)
paragraphs: A short selection of DO Pla de Bages wineries with visits or tastings by prior booking. Confirm times and places with each winery or via the DO Pla de Bages wine route / Bages Turisme before you go.
items: Heretat Oller del Mas (Manresa): visits to the cellar, vineyard and estate. About 10 minutes by car from QEhome.
Collbaix Celler el Molí (Manresa): guided visit and tasting Monday to Saturday by booking. About 15 minutes by car.
Mas de Sant Iscle (Sant Fruitós de Bages): visitable DO winery. About 10 minutes by car.
Abadal (Santa Maria d'Horta d'Avinyó): visits and tastings at one of the reference wineries in Bages. About 25 minutes by car.
Grau i Grau (Castellfollit del Boix): visits according to the winery schedule. About 25 to 30 minutes by car.

sections.title: A 2-day wine itinerary
paragraphs: A typical weekend from Manresa, without trying to visit every winery.
items: Friday: arrive in Manresa, self check-in at QEhome and dinner in the centre.
Saturday: morning at a nearby winery (Oller del Mas or Collbaix). Lunch on the estate or back in Manresa. Afternoon landscape, stone wine vats or a short second visit.
Sunday: historic centre of Manresa, or a slightly farther winery (Abadal or Mas de Sant Iscle) before leaving.
Alternative: one day of wineries and another at Montserrat, about 30 minutes by car.
